facts.text: I am considering getting a new air filter for my car.
I am not sure whether a high-performance air filter is worth the extra cost.
I replaced my air filter myself last Saturday.
My car had trouble accelerating uphill during my road trip to Vegas last month.
I suspected the trouble accelerating uphill was due to a dirty air filter.
I have been driving my current car, a silver Honda Civic, for about 5 years.
I am considering replacing my spark plugs soon.
I am thinking of doing the air filter replacement myself.
I am not sure if I have the right tools or experience to do it myself.
I have been meaning to call Progressive to get a quote for my car insurance.
I saw a leather steering wheel cover at an accessory store near the mall.
The leather steering wheel cover I saw cost $40.
I am considering getting a steering wheel cover to protect my wheel from the sun's UV rays.
